questions.question: What chemical substance is genetic material made of?
Which of the following best describes the chemical structure of a DNA molecule?
options: A single circular loop of proteins
A long chemical molecule made of two chains of smaller chemical units joined together
A short, branched chain of lipid molecules

questions.question: What term is used to describe all of the DNA found in a cell?
What shape do the two chemical chains of DNA form when they spiral around one another with links across the middle?
While individual DNA molecules cannot usually be seen with the unaided eye, under what condition can DNA become visible without a microscope?
options: When it is stained with bright food dye
When a lot of it is extracted and clumps together
When it is heated to boiling point
When it is dissolved in pure water

questions.question: Into what tightly-packed structures is the wound-up DNA of a genome organized?
How many pairs of chromosomes are typically stored in the nucleus of a human body cell?
What are the sections of DNA in chromosomes called that store instructions for inherited features and life processes?
What is the main role of the non-coding sections of DNA in a chromosome?
options: They contain instructions that control when the information in genes is used
They store the codes for building eye colour
They carry out respiration in the cytoplasm
They form the outer protective cell wall

questions.question: In plant, animal, and fungi cells, where is the genetic material stored?
Where do bacteria, which lack a nucleus, store their genetic material?
What is the biological process called where organisms pass on physical and life process features to their offspring?
Except for identical twins, what is usually true about the appearance of offspring?
options: They are completely identical to only one parent
They vary and are not identical to their parents or one another
They have completely different species features
They share zero features with their siblings

questions.question: Which types of features cannot be passed on to offspring through heredity?
options: Features caused by lifestyle and the environment
Features coded by genes in the nucleus

questions.question: Which of the following pairs correctly identifies a genetically inherited feature and an environmentally caused feature?
options: Height (environmental only) and finger length (environmental only)

Which scientists used the X-ray picture evidence from Franklin's group to complete a model describing the double helix structure of DNA?
